sources.title: Reactive Diffusion Policy: Slow-Fast Visual-Tactile Policy Learning for ...
sources.snippet: Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP) is a slow-fast imitation learning algorithm that can model complex behaviors with a slow policy network and achieve closed-loop control based on tactile / force feedback with a fast policy network.

sources.title: Reactive Diffusion Policy: Slow-Fast Visual-Tactile Policy Learning for ...
sources.snippet: Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP) is a slow-fast imitation learning algorithm that can model complex action trajectories with a slow policy network and achieve closed-loop control based on high-frequency tactile / force feedback with a fast policy network.
